was: Local (Forest Preserve District of Kane County). 96 improved drive-in electric/water sites (handles 50-ft rigs), 2 dump stations, no showers; also tent + a few equestrian sites (general campground). Ponds/creek in preserve but not RV-site-adjacent. Seasonal May 1-mid Oct; reservations. --Claude

was: Local (Rock Island County Forest Preserve District, Illinois City). RV camping in White Oak (26 water/electric sites) + Deer Haven (35 full-hookup 50A pull-throughs); showers, marina/boat rental on 167-acre Lake George, 12+ mi trails; separate equestrian loop. RV loops not on the water. Reservable, 2-night min, Apr-Oct. RV Life ~9/10. RV Life mislabels state; it is county FP. --Claude

was: Local (Champaign County Forest Preserve District, Penfield). 65 sites (53 electric, 48 electric+water), on-site host, flush toilets/showers, summer swim beach, 11 dark-sky sites; small ponds not RV-site-adjacent. Reservations required. --Claude

was: Wooded campground on the edge of the historic village, with a separate basic loop to the north. Big Soldier Lake is a 4-acre fishing pond beside the electric loops. Off-season (Nov 1-Mar 31) brings no water, showers or firewood. --Claude
note: Wooded campground on the edge of the historic village, with a separate basic loop to the north. Big Soldier Lake is a 4-acre fishing pond beside the electric loops. Off-season (Nov 1-Mar 31) brings no firewood. --Claude

was: Trout park with five campgrounds: #1 with full hookups beside the spring branch in the valley, open all year, and #2-#5 up a steep hill in the woods. Family sites hold two camping units. --Claude
note: Trout park with five campgrounds: #1 with full hookups beside the spring branch in the valley, and #2-#5 up a steep hill in the woods. Family sites hold two camping units. --Claude

was: Wooded campground in five loops north of the shut-ins day-use area: Loop 1 equestrian, Loop 2 full hookups, Loop 3 electric, Loop 4 basic and Loop 5 walk-in tent platforms, plus camper cabins. The shut-ins parking lot normally fills by 10 a.m. Memorial Day to Labor Day. --Claude
note: Wooded campground in five loops north of the shut-ins day-use area. The shut-ins parking lot normally fills by 10 a.m. Memorial Day to Labor Day. --Claude

was: Wooded campground on one long loop road; Lakes Buteo and Clearfork are nearby but not beside the sites. Sites 1-25 stay open all year; sites 26-60 close November 1-April 14. Generators are prohibited in the campground unless the park manager approves. --Claude
note: Wooded campground on one long loop road; Lakes Buteo and Clearfork are nearby but not beside the sites. Generators are prohibited in the campground unless the park manager approves. --Claude

was: Small campground near the Locust Creek wetland with 26 30-amp electric and 12 basic sites; showers and water April 15 - October 31. Reservable online up to 12 months ahead; unreserved sites can be taken walk-up. --Claude
note: Small campground near the Locust Creek wetland. --Claude

was: Three campgrounds in the Roaring River valley near Cassville, about 1.3 km apart. The spring-fed river here is a stream about 15-25 m wide; Campground 2's sites 093-094 at the end of its loop sit on the bank, and the lower Campground 1 sites (070-072) are a short walk through woods from it. Campground 1 stays open year-round with its showerhouse and frost-free water. --Claude

was: Four wooded campgrounds near Cameron, south of small Lake Allaman. Campgrounds 1 and 2 stay open all year; 3 and 4 close November to mid-April. The booking site lists every basic pad at 20 ft; the electric pads run 38-99 ft. Park gates close at 9 p.m. in season and at sunset off-season. --Claude

was: U-pick berry farm with five electric RV spots at the front, among tent sites; water spigot about 15 ft from the RV sites, gray-water dump only ($10). Farm play park and splash area for a per-person fee. --Claude

was: Wooded campground on 44 acres of oaks a few minutes from Bagnell Dam, with gravel, shaded sites, a swimming pool (mid-May to mid-September), nature trails, a dog park and a bike pump track. Seasonal and monthly sites are sold besides the nightly ones. --Claude

was: Fall River SP's primitive campground on the lake side at the north-east end of the dam, across the lake from the Fredonia Bay hookup sites. No hookups: all 17 sites are primitive and booked as tent sites; the gravel back-ins 407-417 list 24-50 ft vehicle lengths (2026-11-06). --Claude

was: West-shore campgrounds in two groups: Sunflower and Scott Creek by the entrance road, and the Russell Crites loops (Pintail Point, Crappie Cove, Quail Run) ~1.6 km north on the points, where the lake-edge sites are. Rabbit Ridge is primitive. Showerhouses in season (Apr 15-Oct 15 per park brochure). Saddle Ridge, on the east side, is the equestrian camp. --Claude
